## Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign

### Project Goal

The goal of this project was to create and promote a student-led service business that could attract Cal Poly Pomona students. Our team wanted to offer a simple, affordable, and convenient car window washing service for students who commute to campus.

### Target Audience

The main target audience was Cal Poly Pomona commuter students, especially students who drive to campus often and may not have time to clean their cars regularly.

This audience was important because many students balance school, work, and commuting. A quick and affordable service on campus could meet a real need.

### Marketing Strategy

The campaign focused on convenience, affordability, and student-to-student trust. Since the service was created by students, the brand felt relatable and easy to approach.

Our strategy included:

- Promoting the service directly to students
- Using simple and clear messaging
- Making the service feel affordable and convenient
- Showing the value through before-and-after visuals
- Building awareness through campus interaction

### Skills Used

- Target audience analysis
- Brand positioning
- Service marketing
- Campus promotion
- Customer communication
- Team collaboration

### Key Takeaway

This project helped me understand how marketing works beyond just ideas. I learned how important it is to understand customer needs, communicate value clearly, and create a brand that feels useful to the audience.

## LA Galaxy Mock Campaign

### Project Goal

The goal of this project was to create a sports marketing campaign idea that could help strengthen fan engagement and connect with younger audiences.

This project connects to my interest in sports marketing because it focuses on how a team can build stronger relationships with fans through digital content, experiences, and brand storytelling.

### Target Audience

The target audience includes young adults, college students, and casual sports fans who may be interested in attending games, following the team online, or engaging with sports content on social media.

### Marketing Strategy

The campaign focuses on making the LA Galaxy brand feel more exciting, accessible, and connected to younger fans.

The strategy includes:

- Social media content focused on fan experiences
- Game-day promotion ideas
- Student-friendly messaging
- Short-form video content
- Community and lifestyle-based sports marketing

### Skills Used

- Sports marketing strategy
- Audience segmentation
- Social media planning
- Campaign messaging
- Brand engagement
- Digital promotion

### Key Takeaway

This project helped me practice connecting marketing strategy to sports and entertainment. I learned that sports marketing is not only about promoting games, but also about building emotional connections with fans.
